question: Which economic interpretations are supported by the sixth collection without changing the frozen municipal network?
scope: Retrospective exploratory descriptive validation, not forecasting, causal inference or new cluster training
unit: Municipality-year with equal municipality weights; years reuse municipalities and are not independent replications
primary_outcome: log_total: log annual mean monthly sum of the five published spending categories
secondary_outcome: p_food: annual mean monthly food share within the five published categories, not the entire household budget
denominator: Beginning-of-year population_total; nominal rubles per resident is a territorial intensity, not resident income or a matching Sber spending amount
paired_population: Within each region, same IDs must have positive attribute/population and finite annual profile/log_total in both years; 33 Stavropol and 38 Saratov expected. Prior core wage/workers requirements do not apply.
largest_rule: Exclude one ID with highest 2023 population in each paired_available region; same ID excluded in both years
main_statistics: Spearman rho; population-adjusted partial Spearman via OLS residualization of average ranks on population ranks and intercept. Ranks and regressions recomputed in every bootstrap draw and LOO subset.
uncertainty: 2000 paired-ID bootstrap draws within each regional sample, same draws by year, percentile 95%; conditional descriptive uncertainty, no correction for spatial dependence or repeated exploratory comparisons
influence: Leave-one-municipality-out minimum/maximum rho and partial rho
cluster_context: Frozen annual leiden_hellinger labels only; rank eta-squared within each region/year paired_available sample, 4999 label permutations and BH adjustment across the four primary region-year comparisons; exchangeability conditional null, not spatially adjusted or stability validation
adoption: No automatic model or panel adoption. Even strong association cannot resolve unknown historical boundaries, source vintage, or low stability of frozen clusters
admission_checks: All 276 values retained separately, source indices compared with cross-publication nominal ratios only as discrepancies; no retail substitutions or automatic filling of 424 prior missing cells
case_comparison: Federal project cash and municipal statistical investments are different series: ratios are arithmetic scale comparisons, never accepted project shares or causal decomposition; absent 2024 cash remains missing
sme: Count candidate source-code groups once per year and region; no accepted historical company join, no 2025 worker values in 2023/2024 features
evaluation_contacts: Both years, prior clusters and model errors have already been inspected. Entire round is exploratory and no fresh holdout is claimed
prohibited_claims: stable economic classes from unstable Leiden labels
pre_result_protocol_refinement: Validator found prior core excludes 10 Stavropol municipalities for missing wage/workers unrelated to this question. Changed to paired_available before association results; retain stable-code sensitivity. Structural missingness audit then found urban_share unavailable in14Stavropol and6Saratov paired municipalities. Moved urban adjustment to explicitly restricted sensitivity before any association result; primary controls population only.
urban_sensitivity: Restrict to same IDs with observed urban_share in both years (expected19/32); report raw and population-adjusted rho on exactly these rows, then also partial rho controlling population and urban-share ranks. Stable urban sample expected9/32: n9 NOT_ESTIMATED under minimum_n12.
missingness: Never impute urban_share=0; pairwise masks explicit, missing population id1947 excluded in both years.
